g.title: FNO_VLA
g.text: — Scattering + DINOv3 vision · FiLM fusion · Fourier-Neural-Operator action head

g.title: fuse
g.text: 3 layers · 8 heads · dim 256 | proprio-gated attention pool over views | FiLM language conditioning

g.title: n_fuse
g.text: shifts features to the named object

g.title: act
g.text: chunk 16 × 6-DoF (Δx Δy Δz Δr Δp Δyaw) + gripper · execute 8/16 @ 20 Hz

g.title: n_head
g.text: limited actions at any control rate;

g.title: leg
g.text: = pretrained, not updated —— train + inference - - - training only (removed at deployment)
